result.instructions: Tools for CallHippo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the users in our CallHippo account and their teams."; "Show the call logs for last week, filtered to one CRM record."; "Add this new lead to our contacts with her number and email.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CallHippo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run callhippo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run callhippo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run callhippo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. callhippo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: callhippo_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users (agents) in the CallHippo account, with their email, status and team. Good first call to find a user id. CallHippo API: GET /user/list.

tools.name: callhippo_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user's details by user id. CallHippo API: GET /user/details/{userid}.

tools.name: callhippo_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams in the account, with pagination. CallHippo API: GET /team/list.

tools.name: callhippo_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts of a user
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to one user, with pagination. Optionally only those updated since a date. CallHippo API: GET /contact/{userId}.

updated_since.description: Only contacts updated on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: callhippo_add_contact
tools.title: Add a contact
tools.description: Create a contact with a phone number, first name, last name and email. Writes to the account; it creates a new record each time it runs. CallHippo API: POST /contact/add.

number.description: Phone number in international format, for example +14155550100.

tools.name: callhippo_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Replace a contact's phone number, first name, last name and email. Send all four values, the current ones included. CallHippo API: PUT /contact/edit/{contactId}.

tools.name: callhippo_delete_contact
tools.title: Delete a contact
tools.description: DELETES a contact from CallHippo. Permanent for the contact record. Call only when the user asked to delete this exact contact; confirm must be true. CallHippo API: DELETE /contact/{contactId}.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user asked for this exact action in this conversation.

tools.name: callhippo_add_dnc_number
tools.title: Add a number to the Do Not Call list
tools.description: Add a phone number to the account's Do Not Call list, for incoming calls, outgoing calls, or both. Adding a number blocks calls to or from it. CallHippo API: POST /dnc/addnumber.

annotations.title: Add a number to the Do Not Call list

tools.name: callhippo_remove_dnc_number
tools.title: Remove a number from the Do Not Call list
tools.description: Remove a phone number from the Do Not Call list, so calls to and from it are allowed again. Removing a number can break a customer's opt-out. Call only when the user asked for this exact number; confirm must be true. CallHippo API: POST /dnc/deletenumber.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user asked for this exact action in this conversation.

annotations.title: Remove a number from the Do Not Call list

tools.name: callhippo_list_call_logs
tools.title: List call logs
tools.description: List call logs (the activity feed) for a date range, with an offset (skip) and a page size (limit). Optionally filter by CRM record id or call SID. Read only. CallHippo API: POST /activityfeed (the vendor takes this read as POST).

crm_unique_id.description: Only logs linked to this CRM record id.

call_sid.description: Only the log of this call SID.

tools.name: callhippo_list_sms_logs
tools.title: List SMS logs
tools.description: List SMS logs for a date range, with an offset (skip) and a page size (limit). Optionally filter by SMS id, sender or recipient. Read only. CallHippo API: POST /sms/logs (the vendor takes this read as POST).

sms_id.description: Only the SMS with this id.

from.description: Only messages sent from this number.

to.description: Only messages sent to this number.

tools.name: callhippo_make_call
tools.title: Place a call
tools.description: PLACES A REAL PHONE CALL from an agent's number to a phone number, and can link the call to a CRM record. Costs money and rings a real phone. Call only when the user asked for this exact call; confirm must be true. CallHippo API: POST /call.

to_number.description: Number to call, in international format.

from_number.description: CallHippo number to call from (must belong to the agent).

agent_id.description: The agent (user) id who places the call.

integration_name.description: CRM name to sync the call to, for example salesforce.

object_type.description: CRM module, for example contact or lead.

object_id.description: CRM record id in that module.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user asked for this exact action in this conversation.

tools.name: callhippo_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List power-dialer campaigns, with pagination and an optional campaign type filter. CallHippo API: GET /campaign/list.

campaign_type.description: Optional campaign type filter. The spec does not list the values.

tools.name: callhippo_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one power-dialer campaign by id, including its settings. CallHippo API: GET /campaign/{campaignId}.

tools.name: callhippo_set_campaign_status
tools.title: Start or stop a campaign
tools.description: START or STOP a power-dialer campaign. A started campaign places real calls to its contacts. Call only when the user asked for this exact change; confirm must be true. CallHippo API: PATCH /campaign/{campaignId}/{action}.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user asked for this exact action in this conversation.

prompts.title: Get started with CallHippo
prompts.description: What you can do with CallHippo here, with example requests to try.
